name: ai-traffic-lights
description: Shared core + Cursor extension + desktop overlay for AI status traffic lights.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @traffic-lights/protocol && npm run build -w @traffic-lights/core && npm run build -w @traffic-lights/adapters && npm run build -w ai-traffic-lights-cursor-extension && npm run build -w ai-traffic-lights-desktop-overlay
scripts.debug:set:running: node tools/debug-bridge-state.mjs set RUNNING "Manual debug: running"
scripts.debug:set:waiting: node tools/debug-bridge-state.mjs set WAITING_USER "Manual debug: waiting user"
scripts.debug:set:done: node tools/debug-bridge-state.mjs set DONE "Manual debug: done"
scripts.debug:set:idle: node tools/debug-bridge-state.mjs set IDLE "Manual debug: idle"
scripts.debug:set:plan: node tools/debug-bridge-state.mjs set WAITING_PLAN_BUILD "Manual debug: plan awaiting build"
scripts.debug:set:error: node tools/debug-bridge-state.mjs set ERROR "Manual debug: error"
scripts.prepare:cursor-extension: npm run copy:extension-assets && npm run build -w @traffic-lights/protocol && npm run build -w @traffic-lights/core && npm run build -w ai-traffic-lights-cursor-extension
scripts.package:extension: npm run prepare:cursor-extension && npm run package -w ai-traffic-lights-cursor-extension
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run sync:hook-kit && npm run dev:app -w ai-traffic-lights-desktop-overlay
scripts.build:desktop: npm run sync:hook-kit && npm run build:app -w ai-traffic-lights-desktop-overlay
